doctorAbout.full_description: Dr. Aditya H Kumar is an accomplished Orthopaedic & Joint Replacement Specialist with expertise in trauma care, arthroscopy, sports medicine, and limb reconstruction. He completed his MBBS from JSS Medical College, Mysore, and MS in Orthopaedics from KS Hegde Medical Academy, Mangalore, where he was awarded a Gold Medal. He holds fellowships in Trauma & Limb Reconstruction (Ganga Hospital, Coimbatore) and Sports Medicine (Manipal Hospital, Bengaluru). Dr. Aditya specializes in knee and hip replacements, minimally invasive arthroscopy, complex fracture management, deformity correction, and sports injury care. Known for his patient-centric, evidence-based approach, he focuses on faster recovery and long-term functional outcomes. He communicates fluently in English, Kannada, Hindi, and Tamil, ensuring compassionate and clear care for patients from diverse backgrounds.
